create_sequence_option: create a Sequence MetaOption that runs a list of Options in order until completion or failure
run_step_method: run the step method on a Sequence to advance the current child option and return an action
configure_terminate_on_failure: configure a Sequence with terminate_on_option_failure to exit early when any child option fails
query_pterm_probability: query the pterm method on a Sequence to get the termination probability for the current timestep
get_child_policies: get the list of child policy Options from a Sequence via the child_policies method
